summary: Steep street with homes within 2-9 m of the kerb on this side.
reasons: Dwellings 2-9 m from kerb along most of it
Cars park here, but under people's windows

drivers.seclusion: Homes sit 2-11 m from the kerb for most of the stretch; no stretch is clear of them.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with resident cars parked along the north side; room for a van but under houses.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; a handful of residents' cars park here.

flags: Steep: 10.9% mean, up to 17% in places
Dwellings within 10 m for most of the stretch
Sandy Creek 213 m away, ground well above flood level
